evidence.source: Swift package topology fixtures plus optional scripts/topology-e2e.sh disposable-kind harness
evidence.note: Unit fixtures cover named/numeric targetPort, protocol matching, no-ready and external endpoints, duplicate routes, policy rules, and graph resolution. The guarded disposable-cluster harness covers NodePort, headless/selectorless Services, external/not-ready EndpointSlices, storage, and RBAC denial with a private temporary kubeconfig, but it was not executed by the current gate.

Final 2026-08-13 presentation-inclusive Release 10k fixture: 10,001 nodes and 94,950 edges; graphBuild 5488.727ms, Outline 1150.021ms, Map 188.782ms, Paths 196.633ms, level 13.646ms, search 42.085ms, one-hop 91.238ms, Port filter 10.37ms, one sample per metric. GUI frame time, RSS, startup, and API latency remain unmeasured.

findings.statement: The chosen Outline-first keyboard hierarchy, typed Paths diagnostic list, and persistent inspector are source-observed and the macOS shell launch is observed, but the original 16-frame reference matrix, narrow behavior, and human accessibility traversal remain unreviewed.
findings.impact: Untested states or narrower windows may still hide context or disrupt the learner path.

findings.statement: The wide fixture visibly distinguishes two complete paths from one partial HTTPRoute and shows typed Service, targetPort, EndpointSlice, readiness, address, node, zone, and container-port hops. A dedicated partial-RBAC integrated screenshot is still missing.
findings.impact: Unavailable-input hierarchy still needs a final rendered-state review even though partial Paths diagnostic status is visible.

findings.statement: Narrow push navigation, loading, empty, error, stale, offline, and reconnecting behavior for the chosen shell has not been runtime-reviewed.
findings.impact: The product cannot claim smooth cross-platform state or responsive parity yet.

verification.method: Render a complete synthetic fixture at wide size; traverse the Outline keyboard hierarchy, selected-root node/fanout-bounded Map, typed Paths diagnostic list, and persistent inspector while retaining one selection.
verification.expected: The scope, breadcrumb, persistent inspector, evidence labels, visible truncation status, and Outline handoff remain coherent.

verification.method: Render narrow empty, loading, error, stale, offline, and reconnecting fixtures; use keyboard and screen reader traversal.
verification.expected: The single-pane back path preserves scope, status, selection, and the same learner copy as wide mode.

verification.method: Render forbidden NetworkPolicy input plus unresolved named targetPort and inspect the typed Paths diagnostic.
verification.expected: Valid hops remain visible; each unavailable or unresolved hop is named; Exposure Status is not presented as reachability.

verification.method: Run conformance fixtures for numeric/named/ambiguous/missing targetPort, protocols, EndpointSlice readiness, and declared container ports.
verification.expected: Port Hops preserve typed fields, source fields, Evidence Levels, and explicit ambiguity.

verification.method: Exercise the eight exact state scenarios in the matrix on macOS and Linux adapters.
verification.expected: Each state has truthful copy, safe retry or next action, no silent empty/complete substitution, and stable selection where safe.

verification.method: Migrate the GTK fixture from historical ExplorerLevel/ExplorerMode/ExplorerPresentation controls, then compare SwiftUI and GTK outcomes for Outline, selected-root Map, typed Paths, persistent inspector, evidence, reduced motion, and narrow push fallback.
verification.expected: After migration, semantic outcomes match; native widget geometry may differ; no Linux topology parity claim is made before this passes.

verification.method: Measure selection/filter/scoped-map/path p95, frame time, startup, RSS, cancellation, and scale at defined fixture sizes.
verification.expected: Results are recorded against provisional budgets without treating graph/table benchmarks as GUI evidence.
